description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Spark Double, adding {C}{C}.
When Spark Double dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
As Spark Double enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Murderous Redcap with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

uses.name: Spark Double
uses.cardState: as a copy of Murderous Redcap
